in_sanskrit.name: चतुर्भुज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chaturbhuj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chatur' meaning 'four' and 'bhuj' meaning 'armed'. The name signifies a deity with four arms.

in_hindi.name: चतुर्भुज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chaturbhuj in Hindi translates to 'Chaudah Vaandhe', which means 'having eight arms'. However, in the context of Hindu mythology, it specifically refers to deities with four arms.

in_tamil.name: சதுர்புஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of Chaturbhuj is 'Caturpuj', which means 'Four-armed'. This name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to deities with four arms.

in_telugu.name: చతుర్భజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of Chaturbhuj is 'Chattabhajam', which means 'The One with Four Arms'. This name is commonly used in Hindu mythology to refer to deities with four arms.

in_marathi.name: Chaturbhuj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaturbhuj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has four arms. A name associated with deities like Vishnu and Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Chaturbhuj
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chaturbhuj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has four arms. A name associated with deities like Vishnu and Shiva.
